_comment: Editorial content for FIL. Every fact is attributable — see sourceNote. No image is attached: no licence-cleared photograph of this company's own facility was available, and a generic stock photo would imply it is theirs.
description: Fateh Industries Limited is a Hyderabad-based footwear manufacturer incorporated on 18 May 1986 as a public company limited by shares. It makes leather shoes — boots, formal shoes and moccasins — and describes itself as a family-owned business built over generations of shoemaking. Its registered address is on Mirpurkhas Road, Hyderabad, Sindh.
sourceNote: Company website (fateh1.com: about us) and the PSX Data Portal company record for FIL, read 2026-10-17.
